why: The national digital strategy document itself - four axes, Digital Master Plan of 12 programmes and 50 projects, 2034 targets and 1105bn FCFA costing; also carries the SN2025 execution rates it supersedes
Presidential instruction of 17 June 2026 to evaluate progress of all New Deal programmes and reforms and to convene the CNN regularly - a dated authoritative statement of the strategy's standing

Distinct event: installation of the 20-member Conseil national du Numerique on 2 October 2025, the advisory organ steering the strategy [parent dedup: repointed at the surviving capture of the same URL]
The operative universal broadband-access programme with its own published targets (1550 localities in 4G, horizon 2028); no standalone Plan national haut et tres haut debit is published
Official launch of the connectivite universelle initiative on 7 February 2026, one million Senegalese to be connected free of charge with priority to unserved areas
Distinct event: ARTP closed the RAN-sharing and FTTH unbundling PoCs on 4 June 2026, confirming feasibility and framing a regulatory change to accelerate coverage
State operator's own account of the national Tier 3 datacentre at Diamniadio, the sovereign hosting and storage infrastructure the cloud policy rests on; inaugurated 22 June 2021
Formal delivery on 24 March 2026 of the national cloud infrastructure on Apsara Stack, stated by the ministry as the foundation of a national public cloud with local hosting of sensitive data

Distinct event: presidential instruction of 17 June 2026 to intensify global and sovereign securing of data and critical information systems, alongside adoption of the critical information infrastructure bill
The national interoperability platform's own portal - the system itself, on X-Road, with API Gateway, Identite Numerique and Data Exchange services

24-26 March 2026: official launch of the platform, 2026 use-case roadmap workshop, and COPIL validation of MVP 1.0 delivering a national interoperability framework, a draft decree and two production use cases

Distinct event: World Bank ISR archived 21 November 2025 recording both the enterprise-architecture and interoperability-platform indicators still at No, target May 2028 - the independent before-state

The dated presidential instruction of 22 June 2021 that all state data and platforms be hosted at the Diamniadio national datacentre and data held abroad repatriated - the operative public-sector localisation rule
Operational application of the localisation objective: national cloud received 24 March 2026 guaranteeing local hosting of sensitive data, presented as the base of a national public cloud
Distinct event: 17 June 2026 presidential instruction to intensify sovereign securing of data, and Council adoption of the bill whose national-storage principle carries the localisation obligation

The national framework carrying Senegal's open-data commitment (OS1 measure 2.1: legal framework for data opening plus a plateforme nationale d'ouverture des donnees); no standalone open-data law or charter exists
Launch of the national Geoportail, ISO-conformant metadata and five thematic data poles opened to the public - the clearest open-data portal launch in the window
Distinct event: ANSD closed a four-day workshop at Louga on 24 June 2026 operationalising Open Data Platform 2.0 in the regions, training services in SDMX and dataset publication

Primary gazette text of Loi n 2025-17 of 27 September 2025 creating the Taxe sur les transferts d'argent at 0.5% capped at 2000 FCFA, expressly covering electronic, mobile and card payments, plus a 0.5% levy on merchant-code receipts [parent dedup: repointed at the surviving capture of the same URL]

The published act closest to a legal basis: vests the minister with a gouvernance transversale des systemes d'information de l'Etat and a statut d'hebergement de donnees; no decree adopting the interoperability framework has been published
4 May 2026 DPI foundations workshop, with the decree framing the interoperability platform still announced as a projet de decret for presentation the next day

Distinct event: loi n 2025-15 article 15 obliges an assujetti not holding requested information to transfer the request to the one likely to hold it within five days - the nearest enacted inter-administration transfer duty. Staged under baseline as it is the access-to-information baseline

The law itself in the gazette: loi n 2025-15 adopted 26 August 2025, promulgated 4 September, published 25 September; 32 articles, creates the CONAI, sets sanctions, abrogates arts 23-25 of the 2006 archives law
Council of Ministers of 29 October 2025 adopted the projet de decret fixing the CONAI's organisation and functioning - the article 31 implementing decree

AFRISTAT's inventory names Senegal's operative statistics legislation - loi 2004-21 as modified by loi 2012-03 - plus the 2005 decrees on the ANSD and CNS and the 2020 visa statistique arretes; no online text of the statute itself proved reachable
